defect.title: pdf-lib PDFForm.flatten() does not implement PDF 32000-1 12.5.5 appearance placement
defect.emits: q 1 0 0 1 Rect.x Rect.y cm /FlatWidget Do Q
defect.requires: map the /Matrix-transformed /BBox bounding box onto the NORMALIZED /Rect
spellingsThatBreak: appearance /BBox written in absolute page coordinates: the mark is translated a second time and lands at twice its true x and y
annotation /Rect written upper-corner-first: pdf-lib reports a negative height, generates a downward BBox and translates by the top edge, so the mark lands one full box low
defect.harm: the opaque interior of a checkbox or radio appearance is stamped over printed source text at the wrong place, and the control it belongs to is left blank

test.onSource: normalizeWidgetAppearancePlacement reports a correction that MOVES an appearance by >= 0.01pt, plus a count of reversed-corner /Rect widgets
test.onArtifact: a flattened appearance XObject whose /Matrix-transformed /BBox lower-left corner is not the origin; that offset is the distance the mark misses by
test.whyArtifactGoverns: a family may reach flatten() on a form with an absolute-BBox widget and still be unaffected, because the widget was dropped unselected or its appearance was regenerated before flattening. Only the committed bytes settle it.

staleArtifactEvidence.blockingIsAtFamilyLevel: every fixture of an affected family is blocked, including one that happens to carry fewer misplaced marks than another

reVerificationOwed.owes: an independent visual and placement re-verification of the rebuilt artifacts
reVerificationOwed.priorVerdictsWithdrawn: any obligation verdict recorded against the stale hashes above rested on incorrectly placed checkbox appearances

ruledOutDespiteASourceThatSpellsItBadly.why: its own committed artifacts carry no misplaced flattened appearance
